$comment: Bytes are not expressible in JSON Schema's type vocabulary. `type: object` is satisfied by every object, so a mistyped literal reached the controller instead of failing check; `type: binary` is not an option, since a validator refuses to COMPILE an unknown type and a published telo.yaml would stop being JSON Schema for the hub, the editor and every third-party reader. Declaring the representation instead is what makes the check fall out: a literal is read only through the plain encoding, so anything else written at a byte slot is rejected statically and a value arriving by reference passes.
name: Telo.Bytes
description: Raw bytes. Filled by reference (an `!include-bytes` embed, a resource output, a CEL expression) or written inline as base64url text without padding, and the runtime asserts the value really is a byte buffer.
